title: Stream Agent
description: agent.yaml: what a Stream Agent is called and runs on. A key left out keeps whatever is stored on Stream.
$comment: Written by getstream agents init. Edits are overwritten. The shortcuts are the router's aliases; a provider/model is always allowed.

name.description: What the agent is called. Must match the directory's name.

description.description: What the agent does, for whoever reads the directory.

mode.description: voice joins a call, transcribes the caller and speaks its replies; text holds the conversation in writing.

llm.description: The model holding the conversation: a provider/model or a capability shortcut.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

subagent.description: The model a voice agent hands its skills to while the voice model keeps talking. A text agent takes none: its llm loads its skills itself. Without one, a voice agent hands them to llm-thinking when the deployment routes it, and answers everything itself when it does not.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

stt.description: The model that transcribes the caller. A text agent ignores it.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

tts.description: The model that speaks the replies. A text agent ignores it.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

sts.description: One speech-to-speech model that hears the caller and speaks back; stt, tts and llm are then unused. An empty value turns it off.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

search.description: What the agent finds out today's answers with: a provider/model or a capability shortcut.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

greeting.description: Said on joining a call, without going through the model.

oneOf.description: The text, said word for word.

text.description: What the agent says on joining. Empty means the agent waits to be spoken to.

mode.description: exact says the text word for word; variation has the model say its own variation of it on every call.

sandbox.description: Where the subagent may run code it writes. Omit it and the subagent works everything out in its head.

plugins.description: Deprecated: rename it to connectors. Hosted MCP servers the agent may reach, named from the built-in catalog.

connectors.description: Connectors whose tools the agent may call. A name alone is a session binding offering every tool. Sent, the list replaces the bindings stored; an empty list removes them.

oneOf.description: A connector id. Bound as a session connection under that name, offering every tool. Never contains __.

name.description: The alias tools are offered under. A lowercase letter, then up to 62 lowercase letters, digits, - or _, never __ and not ending in _.

connector.description: The connector id. Defaults to name.

connection.description: A connection id, or the label of exactly one connection, bound fixed. Omitted, the binding is a session connection.

tools.description: Tool names or path.Match patterns to offer. Omitted offers every tool.

required.description: Whether a session needs this connector. Omitted is false.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers outside the catalog, opened by their URL.

name.description: What its tools are prefixed with, as <name>__<tool>.

tools.description: Offer only the tools matching these names or path.Match patterns. Omitted offers every tool.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes its login asks for. Omitted, the login asks for what the server advertises.

user.description: Each end user logs in with their own account. Omitted, the app logs in once.

keyterms.description: Words the transcriber would otherwise get wrong, such as product or company names.

tags.description: Cost labels carried onto every request the agent makes.

video.description: What a skill with capture_video sees.

source.description: A participant/track or a processor source. Omitted requires one unambiguous available source.

max_frames.description: How many recent frames are captured for a visual task.

app.description: The application's own section, never sent to Stream. The one place any key is allowed.
